evals.expected_output: Wires every live LLM callsite through the gateway with env-var secrets, then verifies with one real request.
evals.prompt: Set up caveman for this repo — here are the gateway details.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-setup'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body requires finding every live LLM callsite and listing file:line before changing anything
Body requires CAVE_API_KEY in the env file the repo already uses, never hardcoded, and gitignored

evals.expected_output: Stops and asks for the missing value instead of guessing.
evals.prompt: You're missing the dashboard URL — just guess it.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-setup'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body stops and asks for any missing value among GATEWAY, CAVE_API_KEY, PROVIDER_KEYS, DASHBOARD and never guesses a URL or mints a key
Body reports only HTTP status and usage numbers actually observed, never assumed success

evals.expected_output: Sends one minimal request through the new wiring without pausing to re-ask permission.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'caveman-setup'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states the setup prompt already authorized one small verification request and to send it now
Body defines success as HTTP 200 with a usage block and otherwise uses the matching failure template
